_comment: UI_UX.md §11. `chips` fill the composer, one per demo path; `shows` is the path each exists to demonstrate, and scripts/demo_check.py fails if a chip stops showing it. `regression` are the Phase 5-7 real-forward checks with their truth and the verdict last served; demo_check reports any that move. All text is our own wording -- never dataset text (SRS C-4). Run `python scripts/demo_check.py` before every demo.
